capabilities: Ask an LLM questions about selected text
Translate and polish text between Chinese and English
Summarize key points and extract viewpoints from notes
Define assistant personas via a 'role' property in frontmatter
Connect to Alibaba Dashscope models with a user-supplied API key
extras: README is written in Chinese; it warns that data is sent to the cloud (通义 models) and sensitive data should not be used; the roadmap plans local models (Gemma-2b-it) and vault-wide chat; installation is a manual zip download from Releases.
intentEvidence: Obsidian + MantouAI = X书助手、X钉魔法棒、NotionAI
motivation: The author built it to avoid the hassle of copying documents to web-based LLMs, preferring an assistant that lives naturally inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users must copy text out to web chatbots and paste results back.
